_readme: Case manifest consumed by fluent/make_cases.py. See docs/FLUENT_PLAN.md.
The two 'placeholder' cases below are STAND-INS. They are overwritten in
Phase 3 step 7 by the active-learning selection: scripts/sweep.py ranks a
pool of unseen NACA shapes x (Re, AoA) by the acquisition score of spec
section 5.8 and emits the real 3 x 8 case lists (uncertainty / FSC-augmented /
random) into this file. Do not hand-tune them into something that looks
sensible -- the whole falsifiable claim is that the SELECTED cases are
harder than random ones, so the selection must come from the model.
The gridstudy_* trio is NOT a placeholder. It is the three-level grid
independence family on one representative case and it runs first, because
its GCI band is the numerical uncertainty quoted on every other case.

cases.note: Grid-independence level 1 (coarse, ~18.8k cells). Representative case: symmetric section, mid-Re, attached flow at 5 deg, so CL and CD are both well posed and neither is near a bifurcation. Run all three levels before any other case.

Grid-independence level 2 (medium, ~43.0k cells). This is the production resolution: every other case in the study runs at level 2, and the GCI computed from this trio is the numerical uncertainty band reported for all of them.
Grid-independence level 3 (fine, ~96.8k cells). Refinement ratio r ~ 1.5 per direction per level, so r > 1.3 as Celik's GCI procedure requires.
